save.summary:
The save module fails round 4 on one must-fix: data loss when two game tabs are open. If the player goes back to an older tab, plays in it again, then reloads it or navigates away, that tab writes its old in-memory profile over storage. This replaces both echoes.profile.v1 and its .bak. The high scores, records and level unlocks earned in the other tab are silently erased. On the real two-tab sequence (dev and production, 2/2) the high scores went from 1 to 0, unlocks from [1,2] to [1] and levelClears from {1:1} to {1:0}; after a reload the Level Select shows Level II locked again. A storage-diff matrix reproduced it 9/9. This breaks PLAN §0 "state is never silently lost" and the spec's persistent high scores and world variables.
